season-23-forever-forward.summary: Welcome to Pokémon GO: Forever Forward! In Pokémon GO, Seasons are periods of time that feature new events, Pokémon debuts, and surprises that all follow a certain theme. As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area and hatching from Eggs. Make sure to explore during each in-game Season to collect and train as many different Pokémon as you can! You’ll also enjoy special bonuses as you do.

pokemon-world-championships-2026-san-fra.summary: Special in-person Pokémon GO activities are available around San Francisco during the 2026 Pokémon World Championships. Explore the city for a Stamp Rally, location-themed raids with guaranteed Location Backgrounds, and exclusive research. The event runs from Friday, August 28, at 10:00 a.m. to Sunday, August 30, 2026, at 8:00 p.m. PDT.
pokemon-world-championships-2026-san-fra.summary_ms: Aktiviti khas Pokémon GO secara bersemuka tersedia di sekitar San Francisco semasa Kejohanan Dunia Pokémon 2026. Terokai bandar ini untuk Stamp Rally, serbuan bertema lokasi dengan Location Backgrounds yang dijamin, dan penyelidikan eksklusif. Acara ini berlangsung dari Jumaat, 28 Ogos, jam 10:00 pagi hingga Ahad, 30 Ogos 2026, jam 8:00 malam PDT.

armored-mewtwo-in-5-star-raid-battles-se.summary: Armored Mewtwo is back! Last seen in 2020, Armored Mewtwo will return to five-star Raid Battles for a limited time during Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale . Armored Mewtwo will appear in five-star raids on both Saturday, September 5, and Sunday, September 6, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. local time. Shiny Armored Mewtwo will not be available during this event.
armored-mewtwo-in-5-star-raid-battles-se.summary_ms: Armored Mewtwo kembali! Kali terakhir dilihat pada 2020, Armored Mewtwo akan kembali ke Pertempuran Raid lima bintang untuk masa terhad semasa Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale. Armored Mewtwo akan muncul dalam raid lima bintang pada Sabtu, 5 September, dan Ahad, 6 September 2026, dari 10:00 pagi hingga 6:00 petang waktu tempatan. Shiny Armored Mewtwo tidak akan tersedia semasa acara ini.
